name: Astrid S tilbake fra verden
summary: The girl from Rennebu, Norway Astrid S travels the world as an artist. This year she'll be doing her first big TV-performance on P3 Gull, but first she'll travel home to perform her new songs for the people she loves the most.

name: Fatal Promise
summary: A fierce revenge melodrama about a girl who is pushed to the edge of a cliff while fighting the unjust and a man who breaks his promise with her and starts a family of his own, reuniting 7 years later.

name: Cops Like Us
summary: Following officers from Staffordshire's overstretched police force as they talk candidly about the frustrations of being on the beat in one of the UK's most deprived cities - Stoke-on-Trent.

name: Peacemakers
summary: Three-part documentary series following groups who advocated for peace in Northern Ireland.

name: Special OPS
summary: One is a relentless hero, the other is a terror mastermind. In a race against time, Himmat Singh and his team are on a mission to end a nineteen-year long manhunt.

name: The Making Of
summary:
The Making Of relives the significant games that helped define football's greatest modern icons, featuring global superstars Cristiano Ronaldo, Neymar Jr and legendary football manager José Mourinho.

The series takes an immersive, in-depth look into their career-defining games. Each superstar re-tells three meaningful matches, revealing the insights of the whole occasion, the emotion of the night and the impact it had on their careers – and their lives. The revealing interviews are accompanied by testimony from other players who took to the pitch that night, including John O'Shea, Rafael Alcántara, Fernando Santos, Roberto Carlos and Julio Cesar, journalists who covered the game and fans who were in the stadium to witness these personal triumphs.

name: Personal Injury Court
summary:
Serious injuries lead to serious settlements. Say "hello" to your new favorite show. Introducing Judge Gino of Personal Injury Court; he'll be presiding over some of the largest claims in TV history. 

M. Gino Brogdon, Sr. is the presiding judge on Personal Injury Court, a legal courtroom program focused on highly-charged cases alleging harm from personal injuries. The former county judge served a decade on the busiest trial bench in the Southeast — Atlanta, Georgia's Fulton County. He presided over a variety of civil cases including gun litigation, wrongful death, high stakes business and construction disputes, trucking, product liability, medical and other professional malpractice cases. Since 2002 Brogdon's adapted the same streamlined approach to mediating and arbitrating nearly 3,000 cases.

name: Animal Maternity
summary: This absorbing new fly-on-the-wall documentary series visits the UK's top zoo breeding programmes, animal sanctuaries and farms as keepers, vets and breeders use the latest techniques and technology to bring precious new additions into the world. The Animal Maternity cameras will be there as new borns have their first feed and attempt their first steps, and as mother and baby bond. But the series also follows what happens when things do not go to plan, as keepers and vets battle to save babies through surgery, adoption or hand-rearing.

name: СВ-шоу
summary: SV-show is a unique show that you can watch on 1+1 TV channel. In it, all genres are mixed in an unusual proportion: humorous, dance, and talk shows. In each issue of the project, it is visited by famous Ukrainian personalities. In the studio, which is stylized as a sleeping car, guests of the project talk with the host and tell their secrets. It is worth noting that the project was led by none other than Verka Serdyuchka or Andriy Danylko.

name: Bouli
summary: The Moon magically brings Bouli the snowman and his snowman friends to life and keeps them from melting.

name: Persia, the Magic Fairy
summary: 11-year-old Persia has grown up alongside the animals on the Serengeti plains of Africa. Twins Riki and Gaku Muroi and their grandfather, Gouken, bring Persia to Japan with them, where she will live with a couple (who Persia calls Mama and Papa) that own a grocery store. During the flight to Japan, Persia finds herself in the "Lovely Dream" where she meets the Fairy Queen, who explains that the Lovely Dream is in danger and requests Persia's help. Giving Persia a magical headband (which can also summon a magical baton) that allows her to transform into a teenage girl, connecting her to the Lovely Dream and allowing her to use magic. She is sent with three kappa back into the regular world with the mission of collecting love energy to thaw the frozen Lovely Dream. If Persia fails her task of collecting love energy or if someone catches her using magic, Riki and Gaku will be transformed into women.

name: Andy's Top 5s
summary: Andy looks back at his 5 favourite things!

name: Corner Shop Cook-Off
summary: Cooking series presented by Clare Grogan that sees Scotland's National Chef and MasterChef: The Professionals winner Gary Maclean take on a different chef in a culinary competition with a twist: to cook the best menu for £15, using only ingredients sourced from a local corner shop.

name: Wildest Indochina
summary: This spectacular series sweeps across the most diverse peninsular in the world. From Malaysia to Southwest China, Vietnam to Cambodia and Thailand this vast area includes outstanding landscapes, historic cities, tropical jungles and armies of animals.

name: Animal Saints and Sinners
summary: Documentary series following the work of animal welfare officers and telling the stories of extraordinary animals.

previousepisode.name: A Pony Saved Me from Myself and Drugs Raid

name: Kald krig
summary: Norway's point of view of the Cold War as never told before.

name: The Forgotten West Memphis Three
summary: The Forgotten West Memphis Three revisits the infamous West Memphis Three case. On May 5, 1993, three eight-year-old boys, Stevie Branch, Michael Moore, and Christopher Byers, were brutally murdered in a West Memphis creek. Now, 25 years later, Bob Ruff and his team are reexamining the case with groundbreaking new technology and investigative insights in the hope of uncovering new information and finally revealing the truth to the families of Stevie, Michael, and Christopher, the "forgotten" West Memphis Three.

previousepisode.name: Part Three: Theories + Part Four: Persons of Interest

name: Bakeaway Camp with Martha Stewart
summary: A culinary retreat that is anything but, through four one-hour episodes the six campers must brave the outdoor elements for a once in a lifetime opportunity to perfect their baking skills under the watchful eye of Camp Director Martha Stewart, along with camp counselors and baking experts Carla Hall and Dan Langan. Together with host Jesse Palmer, Martha leads the bakers through challenges each episode that test their skills over two rounds, with the most impressive baker of the first heat getting a personal one-on-one mentoring session with their idol, Martha, in her home kitchen. Equal parts baking boot-camp and camp-inspired games and challenges, the baker that displays the least amount of progress at the end of each episode will pack their bags and head home, with the last camper standing winning a kitchen filled with appliances worth $25,000. Welcome to Bakeaway Camp!

name: Murder House Flip
summary: Home designers Joelle Uzyel and Mikel Welch help homeowners renovate the most infamous murder houses.

name: Talking Heads
summary: Series of dramatic monologues written by British playwright Alan Bennett.

name: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
summary: Andy is jetting off all over the world and meeting amazing animals living in and nearby water. Get ready to explore oceans, rivers and lakes with Andy in his incredible Safari Sub.

name: Fake Affair
summary: Shoko has never had a serious relationship. Before she knew it, she was 32 and had become the poster child for all sorts of unflattering labels society puts on unmarried women: "30s and single," "the temp worker who got tired of looking for a husband," and because she still mooches off her parents, "parasite single."

name: Huvaa
summary: Huvaa is a Maldivian romantic drama web television series developed for Baiskoafu by Fathimath Nahula. The series revolves around a large happy family and the impact of an incident that turns their lives upside down while revenge and discord rip the family apart. The series is produced by Baiskoafu.

name: Ehenas
summary: Ehenas is a Maldivian drama web television series developed for Baiskoafu by Ravee Farooq, based on the 2012 novel Ehenas Hama Loabiveyey by Ahmed Iqbal.The series follows the experiences of a long-term domestic and sexually abused male victim and how he faces the societal obstacles of marriage.

name: Заряджені
summary: The already familiar group of young friends has unusual abilities! However, they are a little specific and instead of helping (after all, you could stop time, rise in the air, spit fire), pretty much spoil the measured life. Andrii «Hliuk», Oksana «Mala», Valiera «Lyzun», Katia «Kipish» i Tetiana Hermanivna «Madam» are new heroes whose abilities cause sincere laughter. Together, they will continue to harness their talents and save the world again! Well, at least they'll try.

name: Подорожники
summary:
The Red family, led by Iryna, had an excellent family business on the Zhytomyr highway, the "Podorozhnyk" restaurant, and for many years dreamed of expanding it. Day by day, year by year, the family raised money to purchase another motel and restaurant complex. Only...

On the long-awaited day X to Zhytomyr, Susanna Fortsa arrives from the heart of Milan and buys this motel and restaurant complex earlier. And she does not come by herself, but with her Italian husband, Mario, a Michelin chef with two stars. And then a hurricane of competition breaks out between two restaurants - "Podorozhnyk" and "Piantadzhinne", two cuisines – Ukrainian and Italian, and two rivals from school days – Iryna and Susanna. Meanwhile, restaurateurs beat pots, the hearts of their children, Ania and Aleks, were linked by Cupid, and now real Shakespearean passions, seasoned with high-quality humor, are boiling on the Zhytomyr highway.

name: Джованні
summary: How to build a family if an ex-wife suddenly returned from her permanent residence in Italy?.. One poor man, a new bride, an ex-wife and two teenagers under one roof! How they will get along - watch in the series "Giovanni"!

name: Ми більше ніж я
summary: 10 years of married life is the limit of Nastia and Maks' relationship. Passion and genuine feelings had disappeared between them, but scandals and a mistress appeared. How to resuscitate marriage? It's simple - to move Nastia's soul to Maks, and his spirit to her body. How did that happen? Watch the series "We are more than I am".

name: Нове життя Василини Павлівни
summary:
Osynivka. A place that God is about to forget. Village teacher Vasylyna Pavlivna is already desperate to change her life – she lives with two children and a man, with whom she is officially divorced. But one day, a woman witnesses a conflict in which criminals kill one another.

Vasylyna Pavlivna wants to call the police, but notices a silver briefcase stuffed with new bills on the passenger seat. At the age of 35, she makes the first rash act - she takes the case with the money. However, this series is not about money, but about how we underestimate ourselves and refuse to take risks.

name: Світ Соні
summary: Sonia works as a cashier in a small district supermarket, and she is an informal leader in the team. But here from Novosibirsk to them send the new principal who decides to restore here the orders. In parallel with the business at work, Sonia and her husband Stepan have to solve daily family problems that are familiar to everyone - a young daughter brings home a new fiance, the younger Bohdan got into a fight at school. And then there is a friend and colleague Liuba constant love adventures. Liuba is a constant source of trouble for Sonia, since all her problems have to be solved by Sonia.

name: Паніка Вова
summary: A popular (in the past) actor, acting as a detective, Volodymyr Boiko becomes a hostage of circumstances and really becomes a detective - no longer on screen. In the investigations, he is helped by a longtime acquaintance, Nick, who is well versed in computer technology. Unraveling one thing, the couple takes on the other - complex, serious challenges, often even murders.

name: Діда мороза не буває
summary:
Dana and Aleksandrs meet on New Year's Eve. Dana's spontaneous decision to adopt a child from an orphanage runs into an insurmountable bureaucratic wall.

The only possible solution to the business problems of a citizen of Latvia Aleksandrs is to obtain a Ukrainian residence permit. A fictitious marriage is the best solution for both characters. However, there are detractors around Dana and around Aleksandrs trying to frustrate our characters' plans.

name: Anime e Sangue
summary: Peter Pan, Cyrano, the Scarecrow from Oz and other famous characters find themselves trapped in our world. The mysterious Sariel offers them a chance to go back to their homes: in exchange they will have to accomplish a mission, find and steal the Shaper.

name: Хамелеон
summary:
The audience is immersed in the complicated story of Zoia, who came to conquer Kyiv. But from the first day, the capital begins to test the girl's strength, throwing up one trouble after another. Zoia finds herself in the epicenter of secrets and dangerous adventures that are tied to her ex-boyfriend Sasha. The girl must find all the unknowns to guess the mysterious equation.

On the way to the solution, Zoia will meet loyal friends and sworn enemies. Love, intrigue and constant intrigues will not even allow you to take a breath, but thanks to her humor and stubbornness, she will move towards the goal. Is this enough to reveal the secret and is Zoia ready for a crime?

name: Вижити за будь-яку ціну
summary: Spouses Vika and Sasha have fulfilled their cherished dream - to start an independent life! They bought an apartment and renovated it... But the happiness did not last long - Vika's parents moved in! How they will get along - watch in the series "Survive at all costs".

name: В полоні у перевертня
summary: Three friends. One illegal shipment. Two countries. Heroes of the series "Captured by a werewolf" got involved in a dangerous adventure. Their friendship must be stronger than a bullet and more reliable than bulletproof vests, otherwise this story will not end well.

name: Богун. Адвокатські розслідування
summary: At the heart of the new show are the workdays of a private detective agency named after the protagonist, formerly a security officer, and today, a lawyer, Oleksandr Borysovych Bohun. Together with a team of like-minded partners - detectives Viktor and Yulia - he conducts his own investigations into confusing criminal cases.

name: Карпатський рейнджер
summary:
The land of his ancestors is plagued by crime. Honest, brave and caring Paul Hordiichak knows what needs to be done to help the spread of theft. 2 + 2 presents a new Ukrainian detective series called "Carpathian Ranger".

The main character of the series is a canadian of Ukrainian origin, Paul Hordiichak, who arrives in the land of Western Ukraine. He is an instructor of the program "Ukrainian Sheriff", but he was not going to stay long in the homeland of his ancestors. However, it did not happen as expected and faced with the evil in the face of the killer, he chooses the path of the hero. He must clear this Holy land of all sorts of villains and make the land safe. Especially since Stepan is a loyal partner at your side. Will Paul be able to beat crime?

name: Козаки. Абсолютно брехлива історія
summary: An ordinary guy from a peasant family named Ivan was once brought up as a nobleman. One day he was robbing the Moscow Tsar. The main character was going to steal the jewelry to buy out his mother from the Turkish captivity. This is where the whole story just begins.

name: Сага
summary: The story of the Kozaks starts before the First World War. Throughout the century, the Kozaks, together with the whole nation, live through various hardships and challenges Ukraine undergoes. They go through the wars, Holodomor and changes of political agendas - The only thing that helps them survive in this whirl is a strong foundation that's held the family all these years: "Whatever happens, we're the family." Frequently this basis of the "family code" undergoes challenges. Rivalry in love, differences in worldviews, little and huge combats - the Kozaks have to go through all of them, and so do millions of other Ukrainian families - What's waiting for the Kozaks in the future? Can they preserve their unique world in which there's enough place for everything - laughter, tears, self-sacrifice, betrayal and big love that has been protecting and uniting the family for generations?

name: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy
summary: A new chapter begins for Lucky and her friends as they leave Miradero behind to live and learn at the prestigious Palomino Bluffs Riding Academy.

name: All Together Now - Danmark
summary: A competition with a twist, All Together Now - Danmark sees a range of talented singers take to the stage to perform in front of The 100 - a unique panel of music experts and performers from all over Danmark. If any of The 100 like what they hear, they can stand up, join in and sing along. The greater the number that join in, the higher the act's score. At the end of the series, one act will walk away with the amazing cash prize. So, who can get The 100 on their feet and singing along?

name: Anjaan: Rural Myths
summary: Spine-chilling stories of malevolent spirits unfold in villages, jungles and haunted buildings across India.

name: Anjaan: Special Crimes Unit
summary: Two police officers, ASP Aditi Sharma the believer and ACP Vikrant Singhal the skeptic, investigate strange unsolved cases, while unnatural forces impede their efforts.

name: Anjum's Australian Spice Stories
summary: British-Indian food writer and TV chef Anjum Anand takes us on a spice trail throughout Australia.

name: Mystic Pop-up Bar
summary: Mystic Pop-Up Bar centers around a mysterious pojangmacha ran by a prickly woman and innocent part-timer as they go around visiting customers in their dreams to help resolve their problems.

name: Rakett 69
summary:
Rakett 69 is an Estonian science competition show, broadcast by Estonian Television and funded by the Estonian Research Council.

The objective of the program is to popularize the natural sciences in Estonia. The contestants run for the €10,000 scholarship to further pursue their career in their chosen field of science. The targeted audience of the program is 75,000 people.

name: Grzimek
summary: Grzimek follows the life and work of the renowned German zoologist, zoo director and book author Bernhard Grzimek.

name: Torn from the Headlines: New York Post Reports
summary: Some of the New York City's most dramatic true-crime stories from the perspective of the New York Post journalists who covered the cases.

name: Taiyou no Kiba Dougram
summary: Crinn Cashim, a member of the guerilla group "Fang of the Sun" pilots the mecha "Dougram" to combat the forces occupying the planet of Deloyer, in order to gain the freedom and independence of the planet of Deloyer from the Earth Federation.

name: Likely Suspects
summary: Likely Suspects was an interactive crime drama where the viewer was treated as a rookie partner.

name: Legend of Lu Zhen
summary: To escape her cruel stepmother, Lu Zhen enters the palace as an attendant. She was quickly promoted through the ranks for her pottery-making skill. During this time, she captures the heart of crown prince Gao Zhan. However, she can never be with him as social status and jealous enemies work against her at every turn. She devotes herself to politics and helps Gao Zhan defeat a coup d'etat. Though Gao Zhan can not make her his empress, he bestows her with the highest position in the land, the female prime minister.

name: Vic the Viking
summary: Son of Halvar, the Viking chief, Vic often accompanies his father and his men on their high-sea adventures. But more often than not, they find themselves confronting unexpected dangers and their first reaction to trouble, is to use brute strength. It's a good thing Vic is along to save the day! Though pint-size and lacking in muscle, Vic largely makes up for it with his cleverness, bravery and team spirit. When it comes to getting his friends out of a tight spot, he'll take on any danger, no matter how big. And he does it with humor, a ton of imagination and a keen sense of solidarity.

name: Dishing with Julia Child
summary: Julia Child was devoted to the art of French cuisine. And starting in 1963, The French Chef single-handedly taught a nation how to cook well, eat well and drink well. Now today's chefs and celebrities delight in six of the most-beloved episodes from her groundbreaking series, offering insightful, funny and personal comments in unabashed appreciation of the first lady of cooking. Bon appétit!

name: Everyone Wants to Meet You
summary:
Being the general manager of a five-star hotel, work has always been the center of Zhang Min's universe, that is until he meets Luo Xi, the only person who could bring him out of his workaholic state. Zhang Min finds himself captivated by Luo Xi's kindness and beauty while Luo Xi sees the gentleness behind Zhang Min's cold and apathetic façade. Luo Xi's childhood friend Tao Lun also has a crush on her; yet she only sees him as an older brother.

As Zhang Min and Luo Xi overcome countless obstacles to be together and even set up their own hostel together, a heartbroken Tao Lun turns his focus to business. When a powerful hotel group tries to take over the hostel, their paths cross again.

name: Teresa de Jesús
summary: A powerful epic mini-series shot on location in Spain that tells the story of one of the most amazing women in history, St. Teresa of Avila. With meticulous attention to detail and historical accuracy, outstanding production values, and an incredible performance by actress Concha Velasco as Teresa, this acclaimed major film production is the definitive film on the life of this great saint.

name: Tower of God
summary: Tower of God centers around a boy called Twenty-Fifth Bam, who has spent most of his life trapped beneath a vast and mysterious Tower, with only his close friend, Rachel, to keep him company. When Rachel enters the Tower, Bam manages to open the door into it as well, and faces challenges at each floor of this tower as he tries to find his closest companion.

name: Cosmic Quantum Ray
summary: Cosmic Quantum Ray is about the teenager Robbie Shipton, who has a shoe box leading to the ninth dimension, home of Quantum Ray. Together with Team Quantum, Robbie is taking on bad guys spread over the whole universe, but also goes to school. There he is bullied all the time, like being slammed in his locker. Sometimes it can come out good, because his locker is leading to Cosmic Quantum Ray's Universe. He has to face numerous enemies like Doctor Brainhead and Mother one of the main villains.

name: Match of the Day: Top 10 Podcast
summary: Gary Lineker, Alan Shearer and Ian Wright bring their insight, wit and wisdom to a new podcast series.

previousepisode.name: Champions League All-Time Champions League XI

name: Too Hot to Handle
summary: On the shores of paradise, sexy singles meet, mingle ... and face a $100,000 celibacy challenge. Can they keep it clean — or will temptation win?

name: Cooked with Cannabis
summary: Cooked with Cannabis challenges chefs to use the title ingredient for more than its best-known quality. During each episode, three pro chefs work against the clock to create a three-course meal based around themes that range from world cuisine to futurist food to the kind of weed-heavy holiday menu that could make even your least favorite uncle seem tolerable.

name: Absurd Planet
summary: A cast of quirky critters and Mother Nature herself narrate this funny science series, which peeks into the lives of Earth's most incredible animals.

name: Youn's Kitchen
summary: Yoon Yeo Jung, Lee Seo Jun, Jung Yoo Mi and Shin Goo are to open a Korean restaurant on an island in Bali, Indonesia, to serve local people and tourists. Taking up the roles of CEO, director and assistant chef respectively, the three get to experience freedom in a foreign place, but they also need to work things out together despite difference in personality and opinions.

name: The Tapes
summary: Set in the 90s, the six-part series follows Sonnyboy and Alice, two cops living in a sleepy town where nothing really happens. They are rattled out of their routines when Sonnyboy receives a series of tapes sent to him anonymously.

name: Anonymous
summary: Anonymous was an Irish television series which concept was to disguise well-known personalities, with the use of prosthetic masks, bestow upon them a fake identity, and set them up in what were intended to be humorous situations for the sake of entertainment.

name: Waka & Tammy: What the Flocka
summary: Eight months after renewing their vows in their dream wedding, hip hop artist Waka Flocka Flame and his wife Tammy Rivera navigate the challenges of married life in their new home in Atlanta.

name: Ollie's Pack
summary: Ollie's Pack is an animated comedy about Ollie, a 13-year old boy who, with the help of his best buddies Cleo and Bernie and monster trainer Captain Wowski, protects and controls a backpack portal to the world of monsters.

name: Camp 71
summary: A group of influencers is thrown into some of the finest nature Norway has to offer. There they will collaborate on completing though challenges, whilst competing. Underway the participants will be tried with demanding mountain trips, precipitous climbing paths, and they'll measure forces both to foots, in kayaks and on bikes. The winner is the one who masters the new circumstances best.

name: Maybe, Maybe Not?
summary: A girl who can read minds has always been an outsider at her university due to her sensitivity to what other people think of her. Suddenly, she meets a senior classmate, and to her surprise, she can't read his mind. As they begin spending time together, they start falling in love.

name: My Woofy Poofy Love
summary: Ah Jung is a un-employed young woman who is looking for a roommate. Her tendency to be over affectionate with boyfriends irritates them and the latest boyfriend also dumps her at a coffee shop. Coffee shop manager cum worker Gumdeol has special ability to shapeshift into a dog and he offers comfort to heartbroken Ah Jung as a dog. What will Ah Jung do when she finds the truth ?

name: Vintage Voltage
summary: Vintage Voltage is a series about a London based garage that turns classic petrol cars into classic EVs! Gareth Jones (presenter/classic car expert) will bring the project in and Richard Morgan and team will take these classic to a new level before Gareth hands it back to the client.

name: Sex & Murder
summary: Iconic series, hit movies, fresh originals, family favorites, and the best entertainment for every mood.

name: El Palmar de Troya
summary: In March 1968, four girls affirmed that they had appeared the Virgin Mary on the Alcaparrosa estate, one kilometer from the village of El Palmar de Troya, in the province of Seville. Weeks later, several neighbors affirmed that they had had other appearances and in the summer of that same year an altar was built that would be the first stone of the Palmarian Christian church. Those first appearances gave rise to a religious empire that expanded throughout the world, broke with the Vatican and appointed its own popes. In June 2018, Ginés, the last Pope of El Palmar de Troya, and his wife stormed the congregation's facilities. It was the penultimate episode of an extraordinary story that navigates between tragedy and surrealism. Scandals, the shadow of sexual abuse, improbable anecdotes and all kinds of accusations have marked the more than fifty years of this religious order to which some consider church and many others a great sect.

name: Petrolhead Planet
summary: Petrolhead Planet is the ultimate automotive travel show. Not only is Jethro Bovingdon your guide to the greatest roads in the world, but he tells you how to find them, too! And if that's not enough, in every episode Jethro has a "modern classic" along for the adventure. We're not talking any old car, either, but the crème de la crème of iconic performance cars from the '80s, '90s, and '00s—think Porsche 911 GT3 RS 4.0, McLaren P1, that sort of thing. A mix of epic landscapes, in-depth car reviews, and useful how-to guides, Petrolhead Planet will have you packing your passport in no time.

previousepisode.name: Spanish Pyrenees in a Mclaren P1

name: Kongen på haugen
summary: Who is the best in absolutely everything? The winner has to master everything from outdoors and nature to stand up, cooking and singing. This will be proven throughout various competitions, not unlike what we've seen in previous reality-programs.

name: Madhur Jaffrey's Curry Nation
summary: Culinary legend Madhur Jaffrey returns to television for the first time in 17 years with this new and exclusive series that sees her explore the British love affair with Indian cuisine, more than three decades after she introduced us to her native flavours, spices and dishes. From London to Birmingham and Glasgow to Leicester, this 10-part series sees Madhur travel around the UK, creating her very own food map and seeing first-hand how Indian food has been integrated into the national way of life and why it's constantly voted as one of the nation's favourite foods. In each episode, her journey will see her seeking out the many different thriving Indian, Pakistani and Bangladeshi communities, and meeting with fellow devotees of their cuisines from all backgrounds and walks of life. As well as being a personal journey of discovery, Good Food viewers will also see her demonstrate how - with just a few well-chosen spices, a main ingredient, and a series of easy steps - anyone, regardless of their heritage and background, can create a huge variety of delicious, authentic but accessible Indian and South Asian dishes.

name: The Killing of Three Thousand Crows
summary: Di Ji is a princess from a vanquished nation. After her country is annihilated by the glass fire, she takes on the name Tan Chuan and hides in Xiang Qu Mountain, a place for cultivation, where she works as a servant. There she meets the outstanding Fu Jiuyun who continuously teases her. But when Tang Chuan goes down the wrong path, Jiu Yun will even risk his life to help her. Unbeknown to Tan Chuan, he has been looking after her for ten lifetimes.

name: Skate Into Love
summary: A speed skating girl crosses paths with the ice hockey god of their school. Despite starting off on the wrong foot, they start on a journey to chase after their dreams.

name: Madhur Jaffrey's Flavours of India
summary: Indian cookery expert Madhur Jaffrey shows how to prepare delectable dishes from six Indian states.

name: Adventure Time: Distant Lands
summary: Adventure Time: Distant Lands continuing the Adventure Time stories that captured imaginations and introduced unlikely heroes Finn and Jake, best buds who traversed the mystical Land of Ooo and encountered its colorful inhabitants.

name: Nikita Unfiltered
summary: Nikita Unfiltered follows superstar Nikita Dragun as she navigates her career and dating life as a transgender woman in Hollywood.

previousepisode.name: Nikita Just Went Off At This Dinner

name: Oprah Talks COVID-19
summary: How can we mindfully move through a crisis while holding on to ourselves and our humanity? In this series, Oprah has remote conversations with experts and everyday people to provide insight, meaning, and tangible advice for the human spirit.

previousepisode.name: The Deadly Impact on Black America

name: Arte
summary: Arte was born into an aristocratic family in Florence during the 16th century Renaissance era. Being female, it was unheard of for one to become an artist. Driven by her love of art, Arte is willing to cast aside her aristocratic lifestyle to become an artist.

name: Kakushigoto
summary: Single father Kakushi Goto has a secret. He's a top-selling artist of popular erotic manga, but his impressionable young daughter, Hime, can never find out! Now he's having to bend over backwards just to keep her inquisitive little mind from discovering what he does for a living. A father-daughter tale of love and laughter.

name: Listeners
summary: Set in a world where the concept of music ceases to exist. the story begins when a boy encounters Myuu, a mysterious girl who possesses an audio input jack in her body. The two intermingle with the history of rock music and embark on an unforgettable journey.

name: Sing "Yesterday" for Me
summary:
Rikuo has graduated from college, but has zero ambition or direction and works in a convenience store. A strange high-school dropout, Haru, keeps coming around with her pet crow. Rikuo still has a crush on his senior Shinako, who is beginning a teaching career, and who shows up in the store one day. Rikuo's relationships with the girls, and his feelings about his life, keep changing as the story evolves, bringing in other important characters—Rikuo's co-worker, the coworker's sister, and a childhood friend of Shinako's, etc.

(Source: ANN)

name: Houkago Teibou Nisshi
summary: First year student Hina Tsurugi prefers to do indoor activities such as crafting. Having recently moved to a seaside town, she runs into an older schoolmate, Kuroiwa, who invites her to join the "Teibou" club and start fishing! Surrounded by eccentric club members, how will Hina's high school life turn out?

name: Tamayomi
summary:
In her Junior High years, the pitcher Yomi Takeda was not able to get very far in a cross-school baseball tournament. Since the catcher on her team wasn't at her level, she couldn't use her signature move, the "Magic Throw," and eventually regretted not being able to use it. After Junior High, she decided to stop playing baseball and went to Shin Koshigaya High School, a school without a baseball club.
There, she found her long lost childhood friend, Tamaki Yamazaki, who used to play catchball with her when they were kids. Tamaki also played baseball during her Junior High years as a catcher, and could even catch Yomi's "Magic Throw!"
Their promise with each other during their childhood could now be fulfilled! Walking together on the road of baseball once again...
The story of the girls who love baseball will begin!

previousepisode.name: Going Out to Eat & So Peaceful~

name: Fugou Keiji: Balance:Unlimited
summary: Daisuke Kanbe, a detective with extraordinary assets, is assigned to the Modern Crime Prevention Headquarters, where only those who have caused problems for the Metropolitan Police Department are sent. There, Daisuke is partnered with Haru Katou. Haru is repulsed by Daisuke's material ways, believing that money isn't everything. Challenging mysteries unfold in front of the two detectives, and they must work together to solve them.

previousepisode.name: All That Glitters is Not Gold

name: Kitsutsuki Tanteidokoro
summary: A ghost was seen on the 12th floor of the Asakusa Juunikai building. A newspaper article featuring the sighting brought together Takuboku Ishikawa, who runs a private detective agency to support his family, and his assistant Kyosuke Kindaichi to solve the case.

name: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!
summary: Eight-year-old Katarina Claes is the only daughter of a duke, living her life peacefully and without incident until she hits her head on a rock... and then remembers that she is not actually the duke's daughter. She used to be an otaku who died on her way to school after spending the previous night playing Fortune Lover, her favorite otome game. After noticing that her current surroundings seem oddly familiar, she is shocked to discover that she has been reincarnated into the world of Fortune Lover as the villainess. The villainess in the game usually winds up dead or exiled, so Katarina decides to use her knowledge of the game and its routes to avoid any bad situations. But is it even possible for the villainess to reach a good ending?

previousepisode.name: Unmei no Hito ni Deatte Shimatta...

name: Aşk 101
summary: While trying to make their teacher fall for a basketball coach, four misfits and a model student find friendship, love and the courage to be themselves.

name: Love Goals
summary: Love Goals, is a show in which renowned family and relationship therapist, Spirit, counsels five celebrity couples who are at crossroads in their relationships. Their challenges range from fame and power, infidelity and communication issues, as well as overcoming childhood trauma. Through an intense two-week therapy program that features both insight-oriented exercises and special guests, these famous couples will face their most challenging conflicts head on, as they strive to achieve their love goals.

name: Семья на год
summary:
The plot focuses on the successful HR manager Marina. She has long been disappointed in men, but all her thoughts are preoccupied with the question of how to become a mother for the glorious boy Denis. She collects the necessary documents and certificates, but due to an old conflict with her classmate Sveta, who now works in the social service, she is denied the adoption of Denis on the pretext that Marina is not married.

The woman recalls that she recently conducted an interview with the charming and kind Seryozha, who, due to his frivolous attitude to life, lost his job. Then she refused the man a job, but now offers him a fake marriage for the money, so that she can adopt Denis. However, it turns out that they will be under the control of social services for a whole year, and the social worker of the Light is looking for any excuse to bring the newly-made spouses to clean water.

name: Cleopatra in Space
summary: Cleopatra in Space is a comedic adventure focusing on the untold story of Cleopatra's teenage years. Viewers can follow Cleo as she is transported 30,000 years into the future, to an Egyptian-themed planet that is ruled by talking cats and where she discovers she is the prophesied savior of the future world. In order to prepare for her role and mission, Cleo is sent to an elite academy where she has to train to take on the bad guys, figure out how to eventually get herself back home to Egypt, as well as tackling the highs and lows of being a teenager in high school.

name: Only I Am 17 Years Old
summary: Childhood friends Kota and Mei were third-year students in high school when Kota suddenly died.  Seven years later, Mei returns to her hometown and visits a place with mid-winter cherry blossom trees that were special to her and Kota. To her surprise, Kota, who is supposed to be dead, appears. He is still 17 in mind and body while she is now 24. Kota can only be here while the cherry blossom blooms. Will he be able to tell Mei his feelings with the time he has left?

name: Wind and Cloud
summary: Xiong Ba received a vision that he soon would dominate the world and decided to raise two orphans named Wind and Rain by teaching them martial arts to support that vision.

name: Koi wa Tsuzuku yo Dokomademo
summary: Nanase Sakura is a 23-year-old rookie nurse. She met Doctor Kairi Tendo several years ago and fell in love with him. To meet him again, she studied hard and became a nurse. After 5 years, she finally meets Kairi Tendo again, but he has a totally different personality than what she imagined. Kairi Tendo, who is 31-years-old, is commonly referred to as the "Devil" at work. He is a level-headed perfectionist and often makes biting remarks to doctors and nurses. Nanase Sakura works hard to receive recognition from Kairi Tendo and she also expresses her feelings honestly to him. Due to her persistence, Nanase Sakura becomes well known at the hospital and she picks up the nickname of the "Warrior." Meanwhile, Kairi Tendo becomes attracted to Nanase Sakura.

previousepisode.name: I LOVE... Let us present the rest of the story

name: Disney Insider
summary: Disney Insider peels back the curtain of The Walt Disney Company like never before. Tune in each week as the series takes fans behind movies, theme parks, destinations, music, toys, and more. Each episode offers three unique stories that capture the magical moments and heartfelt storytelling that is Disney. We will be there first, to share our amazing stories, and through unrivaled access fans will see the true magic behind all things Disney.

previousepisode.name: Sketchbook Ornaments, Disney's S.E.A. Secrets, Developing Big City Greens

name: Deadliest Catch: Bloodline
summary: Fueled by the chance discovery of Phil Harris' old Hawaiian charts, Josh Harris is on a mission to find out about his father's secret dream and pick up where he left off by using the maps to follow in his dad's footsteps fishing in Hawaii.

name: NASCAR All In: Battle for Daytona
summary: Chronicling the commitment, struggles and sacrifices of drivers, their teams and families in the chase for greatness at the 2020 DAYTONA 500; a behind-the-scenes look at the highs and lows of real-life NASCAR racing for drivers.

name: The Boys in Green
summary: The story of the greatest period in the history of Irish football, as the achievements of Jack Charlton's team put Irish football firmly on the global map.

name: Nieuw Zeer
summary: Sketch series about the hot issues of today that is talked about and shouted about a lot, but not laughed about enough. From fake news to healthcare, from climate to #metoo, from integration to Piet.

name: Waar Is Dat Feestje
summary: Henny Huisman investigates how the Netherlands celebrates. Henny goes to various parties for this as an uninvited but very welcome guest. Without an invitation, Henny goes to all the fun and special and fun parties.

name: Floortje Terug Naar Het Einde Van De Wereld
summary: Floortje Dessing will return to a few old acquintances she met over her past years of travel. Do they still live at the end of the world or have their lives taken a different turn?

name: The Big Escape
summary: 12 Dutch celebrities compete against each other in elaborate, custom-designed escape room challenges across various unique locations (e.g., abandoned prisons, old factories, trains, or fortresses).

name: Imogen's Face
summary: The beautiful Imogen has just given birth to twins, and asks her sister Amanda to cover for her while she spends time with her lover.

name: Novoland: The Castle in the Sky 2
summary: Powerful forces are searching for the only daughter of Feng Tian Yi and Yi Fu Ling in a plot to urusp power by holding her hostage. Feng Ru Che's  father once told her, don't tell a man that he's handsome because she might just fall for him. Feng Ru Che who represents the next generation falls into a fated romance with Xue Jing Kong.

name: Sparking Joy with Marie Kondo
summary: In this reality series, Marie Kondo brings her joyful tidying tactics to people struggling to balance work and home life — and shares her own world.

name: National Anthem
summary: National Anthem is the tragically funny story of a middle class midwestern family tumbling down the ladder of American society; periodically bursting into song as they struggle to catch themselves.

name: Borderforce USA
summary: Following the Department of Homeland Security Customs and Border Protection agency as they operate on the 28 bridges connecting the United States of America and Mexico.

name: Secrets of the Driving Test
summary: An insight into the world of the driving test, filmed over a two-year period and offering unprecedented access to the Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA), with cameras fitted inside and outside of the test car.

name: Crime Beat
summary: Crime Beat is a true crime series that takes viewers deep into some of Canada's most infamous criminal cases. Hosted by Antony Robart and based on the highly successful podcast by Nancy Hixt, Crime Beat showcases some of the best investigative crime reporting from the Global News reporters who covered the stories in real time. Using extensive archives, intimate family interviews, each week Crime Beat reveals new details that go beyond the news headlines: giving a voice to victims and their families, unraveling how each case was solved through the eyes of the detectives and forensic specialists, and exploring lasting impacts on the community and justice system.

name: Schlag den Star
summary: Schlag den Star is a ProSieben game show produced by Raab TV and Brainpool. The concept is a variant of the Saturday evening show Schlag den Raab. In each issue, a candidate competes against a prominent opponent in up to nine different disciplines.

previousepisode.name: Lilli & Luna Schweiger vs. Cheyenne & Valentina Pahde

name: Faites entrer l'accusé
summary: A look back at a criminal case that made the court record. Each episode recounts one of the major French criminal cases tried since the 1950s.

name: Celebrity Murder Mystery
summary: Well-known faces travel back in time to the 1920s for the ultimate murder mystery weekend. The participants have just four days, relying on their wits and the best forensic techniques the era has to offer.

name: Doctor Who: Real Time
summary: What interest can the Cybermen have in the ruins of the planet Chronos?

name: Doctor Who: Shada
summary: The most dangerous book in the universe has been stolen.

name: Doctor Who: Death Comes to Time
summary: Doctor Who: Death Comes to Time follows the adventures of the seventh doctor as he attempts to stop General Tannis' plans for conquest of the universe.

name: Vijf tinten verder
summary:
Vijf tinten verder is a five-part mini-series on Vitaya, based on the book Fifty Shades of Gray by E.L. James.

The miniseries consists of five episodes, each dealing with a different subject within sexuality. The set-up is scripted reality, in which everything is staged, but which creates the feeling that it is reality television. The main characters in this mini-series play ordinary Flemish people who want to make their relationship more exciting.

name: Drug Wars: The Cocaine Cartel
summary: DEA agents (Alex McArthur, Dennis Farina) execute a three-part plan to bring Medellin cartel leaders from Colombia to justice.

name: Airport Security: Peru
summary: Jorge Chavez International Airport, Lima, Peru - Peru's largest airport and a major Latin American hub. The biggest security challenge here: cocaine trafficking. And anti-narcotics police work 24/7 to bust the latest ingenious scheme: ingested capsules, drug-infused clothes, hidden compartments, and much more. Watch the action first-hand through exclusive access to some of the airport's most restricted areas.

name: Married at First Sight: Second Chance
summary: Three former candidates of 'Married At First Sight', Milly, Marcel and Maxime, make another shot at love. They are helped by the experts with the pre-selection of candidates, but they themselves decide with whom they want to go on a date. In addition, no rings will be exchanged. Will she manage to find love this time?

name: Drug Wars: The Camarena Story
summary: Fact-based story of undercover DEA agent Enrique Camarena who, while stationed in Guadalajara, uncovered a massive marijuana operation in Northern Mexico that led to his death and a remarkable investigation of corruption within the Mexican government.

name: Моя большая армянская свадьба
summary: Tigran, a popular plastic surgeon in Moscow with roots in Armenia, and Lena, a well-educated and beautiful Russian woman, are in love. Families on both sides are mostly against the prospect of a "mixed marriage" and therefore devise various schemes to derail the impending engagement. Hilarious situations develop.

name: &Music
summary: Music has many masters. Some play instruments. Others computers. Some balance audio levels. Others balance minds. But they all play a critical part in making the artform sing.

name: Angry Birds: Summer Madness
summary: Angry Birds: Summer Madness sees much-loved birds Red, Bomb and Chuck, as well as a cast of brand new feathered friends, as tween birds at summer camp under the questionable guidance of their counselor Mighty Eagle. Explosive antics, improbable pranks and crazy summertime adventures see the birds pushing boundaries and breaking all the rules while fending off the brash and obnoxious Pigs on the other side of the lake, who seem hell-bent on causing as much mayhem as possible!

name: Legends of the Wild
summary: Across the planet, there are startling reports about strange animal attacks against humans, new apex predators changing the natural order, and sightings of mysterious creatures that nobody can explain. Now, two lifelong friends and wilderness experts, Damian Duffy and Matt Hoffmann will use their combined skills in an attempt to document, discover and solve the most extraordinary mysteries of the natural world.

name: Car Kings
summary: In 1952, Galpin Auto Sports revolutionized the automotive world by becoming the first dealership to ever design, build and sell a custom car, transforming the business into the most storied customization shop in the entire game. Now, Galpin Motors, Inc. president and COO Beau Boeckmann, custom car builder Dave Shuten and customization specialist "Mad Mike" Martin are revving up engines to save automotive history and rescue car culture from oblivion.

name: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
summary: James Martin sets off on his foodie travels across the UK. Each day James will be accompanied by a top chef.

name: You Ain't Got These
summary: This is not a show about sneakers. It's a show about sneaker culture. Fitting in. And belonging to something bigger than yourself. Best of all? Lena Waithe is in it.

name: Big Weekends with Gregg Wallace
summary: Gregg Wallace visits some of Europe's best cities. At each destination, Gregg will get to soak up the history and absorb the local cuisine, mixing his passion for travel and food.

name: Un medico in famiglia
summary: Un medico in famiglia tells the story of the Martini, a family which initially consisted of a widowed doctor with three children and his father, who move to Poggio Fiorito, where he is divided between his relatives and the experimental CHS (ASL in Italian) in which he works. With the passing of the seasons and the continuous change of the cast, the family has undergone profound changes.

name: Promis unter Palmen
summary: Ten celebrities (or those who think they are) share a magnificent villa on the palm beach in Thailand and are faced with all facets of living together. Of course, they have to go to their mental and physical limits and never know who they will have to work with as a team to reach their goal. In each broadcast, new balance of power and team constellations should arise. In the end, however, everyone is a lone fighter with only one goal: to take home the profit of 100,000 euros and the fame as the winner - and maybe also one or two new Instagram followers.

previousepisode.name: Finale mit Rekord-Jackpot: Wer gewinnt "Promis unter Palmen" 2026

name: Craig Ross Jr's Monogamy
summary: Craig Ross Jr's Monogamy is an ensemble drama about 4 couples from all over the country who travel to Los Angeles to undergo a new type of treatment called Swap Therapy to repair their broken marriages. Swap Therapy is the process of switching spouses in order to better define and thus fix, what's lacking in your own relationship.

name: My Perfect Landing
summary:
My Perfect Landing follows a family of gymnasts through their struggles of dealing with a life-changing move from Miami to Toronto, Canada.

Jenny Cortez, a talented young gymnast, moves from Miami to Toronto when her family gets the opportunity to run their own gym. With new friends and an intimidating new school, Jenny looks to perservere and become the gymnastics legend she was born to be.

name: Sammen
summary: A humour program about unity where famous and dear artists, comedians, celebs and hosts open up to show that we, in a pretty chaotic time, aren't alone.

previousepisode.name: Hanne Kristin Rohde, Bjørn-Henning Ødegaard, Finn Schjøll, Eirik Newth, Solveig Kloppen, Albert Kloppen

name: Stone Cold Steve Austin: The Broken Skull Sessions
summary: Filmed at Austin's home studio in Southern California, each episode of The Broken Skull Sessions will contain more than an hour of engaging, candid conversation with guests who've accomplished success similar to the decorated six-time WWE Champion.

name: WWE The Day Of
summary: A behind the scenes look at some of WWE's biggest events.

name: Разведчица. Легенда об Ольге
summary: The life story of Russian actress Olga Chekhovа. The first marriage, first disappointment, then - hasty departure to Germany. She, unknown to anybody Russian, became an actress of the State of the Third Reich, a close friend of Hitler and Hering.

name: Dark Side of the Ring: After Dark
summary: Host Chris Gethard dives deeper into Dark Side of the Ring and wrestling subculture with a panel of celebrity guests.

name: Mewkledreamy
summary: The story begins when a middle school girl named Yume sees something fall from the sky, and meets a pale violet-colored kitten named Mew. It turns out that Mew has the power of "Yume Synchro" (Dream Synchro), the power to enter dreams. In the dream world, the girl and Mew collect Dream Stones.

name: BNA: Brand New Animal
summary: The series is set in the 21st century, where the existence of humanoid animals that have been living in the darkness for centuries have been revealed to the world. One day, Michiru, who was a normal highschool student, suddenly turns into a tanuki person; running away, she seeks refuge in Anima City, a place set up for humanoid animals to be able to live as themselves. While there, Michiru encounters a wolf person, Shirou Ogami, who goes on to investigate why she became a humanoid animal, and in the process gets mixed up in even stranger events.

name: Épidémie
summary: A dangerous virus is spreading in Montreal among a group of ostracized and vulnerable homeless people. How long will Anne-Marie Leclerc, infectious disease specialist and director of the Laboratory for Emergency Health, take before realizing the existence of this highly contagious disease? Will it be too late to prevent a deadly epidemic from spreading throughout the population?

name: DOC - Nelle tue mani
summary: Andrea Fanti loses his memories of the last twelve years of his life because of a cerebral trauma, and, for the first time, he finds himself not to be the smartest, renowned medic as usual, but a simple patient. Without the memories from his life, the man falls in an unknown world where loved ones are strangers, and the hospital becomes the only place where he truly feels at home. Inspired to the real life of Doctor Pier Dante Piccioni.

name: #FreeRayshawn
summary: When an Iraqi War veteran is framed by the cops for a drug deal, he is forced to take refuge inside his apartment building with his family.

previousepisode.name: He Just Wanted to Be Heard

name: Anne+
summary: The weekend Anne moves into her own place she unexpectedly runs into her ex-girlfriend Lily. Lily was her first girlfriend and a lot has happened since they broke up four years ago. Over the weekend, Anne reflects on the relationships she has had throughout her student years in Amsterdam. In six episodes we learn about Anne's turbulent love life and how these diverse girls and various relationships have contributed to who she is today.

name: Criminal Justice
summary: Sex, drugs and a gruesome murder. An edgy one night stand turns into a nightmare for Aditya, when he wakes up with blood on his hands. The evidence is stacked against him, but he doesn't remember the grisly crime. Is he guilty or not?

name: Freud
summary: David Suchet, beloved portrayer of the peerless Inspector Poirot, puts his acting skills into the guise of another famous mind. Suchet shines in this award-winning performance as Sigmund Freud, the father of psychoanalysis and one of the revolutionary thinkers of the 19th and 20th centuries.

name: Afsos
summary: Nakul's only goal in life is to finish it. After several failed suicide attempts, he pays for his own death. Upadhyay, a deadly assassin is assigned to get the job done. But Nakul has a change of heart. He chooses to live, however Upadhyay never leaves a job undone. An riveting cat and mouse chase ensues while a divine intervention flips everything upside down in this black comedy thriller.

name: The Investigation
summary: An investigative officer of Mumbai Crime branch, on a routine day, gets a murder case on his desk to solve. Instinctively he knows that he was responsible for this death. Would he surrender and go to jail for this murder? Or would he use his intellect and all the crime branch resources at his disposal, to frame someone else? Was it an accidental murder or a mastermind behind this heinous death? Watch the investigation to find out a brilliantly devious plot to unearth an altercation gone wrong - or is there really something else to this he-done-it mystery murder?

name: Smoke
summary: Set in Goa, Smoke explores the dark web of drugs, mafia, and power. With the cartels at war, who will survive?

name: Rangbaaz
summary:
Shiv Prakash Shukla, a 25 year old boy from Gorakhpur becomes the deadliest gangsters of Uttar Pradesh in 1990s. He works for powerful politicians and is involved in organized crimes. The state government forms a Special Task Force lead by Siddharth Pandey who start tracking his mobile phone location to apprehend him.

Rangbaaz Phirse is the second season of ZEE5's flagship franchise Rangbaaz. The series stars Jimmy Sheirgill, Gul Panag, Sharad Kelkar, Spruha Joshi, Harsh Chhaya and Sushant Singh. It is the story of a young guy who falls through the cracks of the society because of ulterior political agendas and is robbed of his youth which subsequently ruins his life. #NotBornACriminal This season will be based on the story of Amarpal Singh, a feared gangster of Rajasthan. It will revolve around his journey into the world of crime. A product of caste supremacy and political rivalry, Amarpal Singh's story is an unusual tale of a dream gone so wrong that it couldn't be rectified after a point - a dream of excelling in every field, a dream of setting an example in the society, a dream of being the best ever.

name: Poison
summary: After getting released from jail, Ranveer moves to Goa to seek revenge on his enemies. Meanwhile, DSP Vikram sets his eyes on Antonio Verghese, a gangster who operates from Goa. The plot thickens when the lives of these three men are entwined.

name: Truth or Tamanna?
summary: Tamanna and Dhruv love each other, but just before the flight to London with Dhruv, Tamanna disappears. The whole story revolves around how Dhruv investigates the matter just for an answer.

name: Miracle Shoujo Limit-chan
summary: As a result of a traffic accident, Limit-chan is reborn as a cyborg and is given three types of supernatural powers. However, there is a catch: if she uses too much of them, her life will come to an end.

name: Asur
summary: A unique crime thriller that pits two opposing worlds against each other. The less explored, intricate world of forensic science and the deep mysticism of ancient Indian Mythology.

name: The Ingraham Angle
summary: The Ingraham Angle cuts through the Washington chatter to speak directly with unexpected voices and the actual people who are impacted by the news of the day.

name: Comedy Against Living Miserably
summary:
Join Dave for a TV mental health fundraiser, Comedy Against Living Miserably, to celebrate our partnership with CALM - the Campaign Against Living Miserably. As well as delivering first class stand-up comedy routines, the show will see the comedians openly and honestly discussing their own relationships with mental health, including issues such as eating disorders, cyber bullying, panic attacks and depression. The conversation merges seamlessly with the comedy routines to deliver a fresh and original take on stand-up comedy for a TV audience. 

Each episode, one each month, will be hosted by a headline act and will feature three leading comedians, all of which are donating their fee to CALM, which will be matched by UKTV.

name: Drunk History
summary:
This scripted comedy series takes Australia's rich, and often surprising, history and retells it through the tipsy words of our most loved comedians and entertainers via the slightly distorted bottom of a beer or wine glass.

These hilarious and skewed historic stories are re-enacted by a cast of comedic geniuses, who use lip sync to bring these dusty tales to life.

name: Stalk
summary: Lux, 18, is a gifted young man who is humiliated by the coolest students on campus as soon as he arrives at his prestigious engineering school. To take revenge, he "stalke" them by interfering remotely in their phones and computers, including that of Alma, the object of all his fantasies. Lux discovers all their secrets and integrates their group to better handle them. He becomes in the eyes of everyone who he always dreamed of being, but for how long?

name: Aruanas
summary: Founded by childhood friends Natalie (journalist), Luiza (activist) and Verônica (lawyer), environmental NGO Aruana is headquartered in São Paulo and operates throughout Brazil. As they untangle a dangerous web of secrets in the heart of the Amazon rainforest, the drama of their personal lives intensifies with their activism.

name: Friends
summary: A comedy-drama series as seen through the eyes of three 11-year-old children from different backgrounds with episodes focusing upon the trials and tribulations of adolescence, and involved subjects such as dating, family, school, growing pains and friendship.

name: The Sauce
summary: The Sauce follows dance sensations and hosts Ayo & Teo as they explore the unique dance cultures in cities across the U.S., finding the freshest online talent to compete head-to-head for a cash prize.

name: Yume no Crayon Oukoku
summary: The civilians of the Crayon Kingdom have always view their Princess Silver as a twelve-year old girl with a beautiful smile. However, unknown to them, the princess has 12 bad habits. This has created much distress to the Chameleon Prime Minister and the Crayon ministers for it would be embarassing if this gets out. One day, a party was held to celebrate Princess Silver's twelvth birthday. The princess was trying to seek her Prince Charming that she forgot to take notice of her bad habits. One of the boys at the party was so angry that he changed Silver's parents, the King and Queen, into stone. In order to break the curse and save her parents, Silver decided to set on a journey to locate the boy. Together with her companions, Silver begins her adventure.

name: Marvelous Melmo
summary: In this story, a girl named Melmo learns the meaning of being a "woman" through countless adventures in which she grows up and returns to being a baby with the help of miracle candies.

name: Clive James: Postcard from...
summary: Series of travel documentaries.

name: The Kill List
summary: Angie is a killer from a secret organization and is ordered to locate a document which is stolen from it's organization by James. She disquises herself as a high-class prostitute to lure James. But when Angie learns about the content of the letter with a new friend, she slowly starts to question her morals and if she's really what she is told to be.

name: The Steph Show
summary: Steph McGovern presents a daily programme live from Yorkshire, including the daily lunchtime Channel 4 News bulletin and featuring a mix of entertainment, lifestyle and a variety of guests.

name: Amensalism
summary:
At the age of ten, Cheng You Kuan experienced an event that would alter the course of his life forever. The sole survivor or a terrible accident, You Kuan was so traumatized by the event, that every night since, he has dreamt of death. Haunted by his terrifying dreams, You Kuan's life only gets worse once he realizes that the deaths he dreams of aren't simply nightmares but are actually glimpses into the future. Knowing when, where, and how the people around him are going to die, You Kuan has spent the past nineteen years haunted by unspeakable horrors.

Convinced his life will never be anything but awful, You Kuan believes he's destined to spend his entire life in utter misery as he sees people's deaths but is unable to help them alter their fate. But everything changes the day he meets Be Ke Zhen, a woman who unwittingly shows You Kuan that a person's fate can actually be altered. Suddenly seeing rays of hope in a world that has been nothing but gloom and despair, You Kuan finds himself falling for the woman who changed everything. But their relationship gets a bit more complicated when they realize they were both victims of the tragic accident that happened so many years ago.

Connected by fate, can You Kuan and Ke Zhen find a way to rid themselves of the ghosts which have haunted them all these years? Or will the ties that bind them, ultimately be what tears them apart?

name: HealthCheck UK Live
summary: Dr Xand van Tulleken and Michelle Ackerley guide viewers through the challenge of keeping mentally and physically healthy while quarantined at home due to coronavirus.

name: If Time Flows Back
summary: A story that follows three men who are coming from their respective failed marriages. They decide to go to the same city to start a journey of healing.

name: Answer for Heaven
summary: A righteous fallen angel must work with a rating-obsessed reporter to investigate crimes as journalists in a highly competitive newsroom.

name: Big Picture House
summary: Big Picture House tells the story of five men and women that failed to prepare to be an idol or have continuously encountered failure but they continue to prepare for it. They live in the same share house while experiencing dream and love.

name: Creatures Unknown
summary: The strange and weird case appeared on Yanbo Island in the south, and the residents of the island disappeared mysteriously. At the same time, a short-haired girl suddenly came to the town and seemed to be closely related to the disappearance. In order to find the missing friend You Shang Jie, the town high school students Fu Jun Hao and Zhang Yu Xuan took the mysterious girl and searched for the truth. At the same time, Sarah, a female high school teacher who lost her biological brother, also formed a team with Su Min Xu, a rich second generation on the island of happy friends. For the sudden appearance on the island, the mysterious black gang launched an investigation ... What is the black mucus appearing everywhere? What was missing from the missing high school student, Shang Shangjie? Why is there a strange sound in the dry well on Haichao Street? Who does the Ph.D.s in those black people point to? Everything shows that a huge crisis is quietly approaching the inhabitants of the island, and the good people know nothing about it ...

name: Reborn
summary: After suffering heavy losses, Qin Chi who is the vice captain of the Xiguan task force works with his colleagues to unlock the mysteries of the past. Meticulous and quiet, Qin Chi is a man of action as he continues to battle amnesia.

name: Animal Rescue School
summary: Animal Rescue School follows candidates realising their dreams of becoming an RSPCA inspector.

name: Love in the Mist
summary: Plerngfah has ability to see the previous lifes of people since he was young. His parent decided to move to live at US in order to treat his strange symptoms. He is no longer able to see weird images or have dream. 20 years later, Plerngfah is back to live at Thailand and work as a news reporter for Channel 6. Several bombing with ancient traces happened cause him to meet Sitang, a young archeology professor. Then Plerngfah is able to see past lifes again. He is sure that Sitang is his soulmate and they has been together for many lifetimes. However, enemies who cause chaos in their previous lifes, still follow them to this world and swear to sperate Plerngfah and Sitang again.

name: Danger of Her
summary: A school reunion, a night spent outside and an article on the internet intertwines the lives of four women who form an alliance - the married Qiao Wei, editor Su Yao, TV producer Nicole and hotel chef He Anxin. Cooking up the perfect plan, they scheme to get back at their violent husband and lying ex-boyfriends yet the threats, intimidation and schemes ultimate result in deaths.

name: UFO Baby
summary: Miyu is an 8th grade girl, whose parents have been hired by NASA. They take off to America leaving Miyu with Mr. Saionji. Later, Mr. Saionji decides to go on a 1 year long trip to India leaving Miyu alone with his son, Kanata. More complications rise when an Alien baby and his babysitter pet crashes/lands in their house. To make things worse, alien baby starts calling Miyu and Kanata Mom and Dad, also showing ESP power and floating around.

name: Fushigi Mahou Fun Fun Pharmacy
summary: In a small town, there is a small pharmacy called Fun Fun Parmacy. Popuri, a girl who recently moved in downtown, discovers this pharmacy and meets Miss Fukiko, who is actually a witch. Miss Fukiko gives Popuri a mysterious bottle that can create magic spirits.

name: Cutie Honey Flash
summary: On her sixteenth birthday, Honey Kisaragi goes to meet her father. However, he shows up injured and on the run. Out of nowhere, a group of thugs and a monster show up. A detective, Seiji Hayama, rescues Honey and her father. Unfortunately, the monster captures Honey`s father. A grieving Honey goes home to find it in ruins, but a handsome man gives her hope and a device to use against the monsters who took her father. With them, Honey can transform into multiple forms and destroy Panther Zora, the evil behind this.

previousepisode.name: Honey is a Bride! The Light of Love Shines for Eternity

name: Քաոս
summary: The TV series is based on Shirvanzade's novel "Chaos".

name: I Am U
summary: After the untimely death of her sister, Elise suddenly experiences uncanny things around her. She feels being followed around, but instead sees an image of herself. It turns out that Elise has a doppelgänger named Rose. Their worlds collide when Rose rescues Elise from an accident one afternoon. Rose looks exactly like Elise, but their similarities end there. Out of curiosity, Elise invites Rose into her life, and introduces the latter to her family, her friends, and even her boyfriend, Kyle. As they develop fondness towards her doppelgänger, Elise realizes that letting Rose into her life is a big mistake. With her jealousy brewing, she bullies Rose during a game of "Truth or Dare" that soon leads to a tragic accident. She and her friends cover up the incident and decide to put everything behind them— until they all fall into their mysterious deaths one by one. Who will be left unscathed? How are the deaths linked to Rose's demise?

name: Astrid et Raphaëlle
summary: When Major Raphaëlle Coste turns to the police criminal records department for one of her investigations, she has no idea that she is going to meet a young woman as brilliant as she is confusing, a living memory of criminal investigations. Astrid, 30 years old, particularity: autistic.

name: Majokko Megu-chan
summary: Megu is sent to Earth in her early teens, she is adopted by Mammi Kanzaki, a former witch who gave up her royal ambitions to wed a mortal. Mammi bewitches her husband and their two children, Rabi and Apo, into believing that Megu has always been the eldest child of the family. Under Mammi's tutelage, Megu learns to control both her abilities and impulses in order to prove her worthiness for the crown. This Rite-of-Passage subtext is continued throughout the series.

name: History of the Emirates
summary: At the heart of the Arabian Peninsula is a nation only 4 years older than Microsoft, famous around the world for its gleaming modern cities - Dubai and Abu Dhabi. But behind the fast cars and the skyscrapers, there lies a compelling and untold story. With unprecedented access, and told through the voices of its people, this fascinating 3-part series reveals how new archaeological and historical discoveries are only now uncovering the true extent of this land's ancient wonders - remarkably advanced civilisations that once held centre stage in world history.

name: Manu
summary: Manu is a French animated series, based on comic books by cartoonist Frank Margerin. It premiered in 1991 and was about a teenager 'Manu' and situations in his own life, with the rest of his family and his friend Robert.

name: Como en el cine
summary:
Isabel is a young woman who, when her parents die, takes care of Rocío), her little sister. In order to pay for the exclusive boarding school where Rocío studies, Isabel begins to work as a dancer in a bar, while making her sister believe that she is a prestigious psychologist.

One day Isabel meets Javier, the love of her life. He, believing that Isabel is an important doctor, puts himself in his hands to heal the trauma caused by the death of his twin brother, and also, to learn to deal with the constant blackmail of Doña Nieves, his mother, who blames him for what happened.

Javier and Isabel fall head over heels in love, but she fears he will leave her when he knows that she is not really a psychologist, but a dancer in a bar.

name: El amor no es como lo pintan
summary:
Alicia Ramírez is a young university student who lives very happily with her father Gerardo, her grandmother María Elena "Mamá Nena" and her little brother Juanito. Furthermore, she is the best student of her career. However, he has to deal with a big problem, his physical appearance.

When Alicia decides to look for a job in different advertising agencies, she is rejected by the bosses, simply because she is ugly, despite having a great preparation. The same thing happens in Segovia, Segovia , where Alberto, the youngest son of Rolando Segovia, owner of the agency, does not want to hire her for the same reason. However, Rolando believes that Alicia has a great preparation and decides to hire her, regardless of the opinion of her son.

In this story Rolando's older son and Alberto's brother, the dreamer César, also appears, who along with Javier, his best friend, try to succeed in the film business. César uses the stage name of Felipe Sabatié, as a tribute to his maternal grandfather. César is constantly harassed by his girlfriend Marisela, whom he plans to leave behind by a young woman he meets in a chat.

César and his friend are movie fans, for that reason they call each other "Cinefilo" and "Cinefila", respectively, in the chat. César does not suspect that the "Cinefila" is actually Alicia and when she discovers that he is "Cinefilo" he is afraid that he will reject her for her appearance.

Alicia reveals her identity to César and although at first she doesn't like the idea, she decides to give Alicia a chance. However, both will have to face the evils of Marisela, who plans to separate them to stay with Caesar. In addition, Alicia will have to endure Alberto's humiliations at the agency, but above all, she will have to deal with César and Alberto's mother, the ambitious Dunia, who believes that Alicia is the lover of her husband Rolando.

previousepisode.name: Астровская, Муцениеце, Пылаева VS Щитков, Амарян, Лаврентьев

name: The Machine Gunners
summary: Chas McGill has the second-best collection of war souvenirs in Garmouth, and he desperately wants it to be the best. When he stumbles across the remains of a German bomber crashed in the woods - its shiny, black machine-gun still intact - he grabs his chance. Soon he's masterminding his own war effort with dangerous and unexpected results...

name: That's My Jam
summary: Hosted by Jimmy Fallon, That's My Jam is an hourlong music and comedy variety game show that draws inspiration from the most popular "Tonight Show" games. Each episode features two teams of two celebrities competing for a charity of their choice in a series of music, dance, and trivia-based games and musical performances. Signature games to be played include Launch the Mic, Air Guitar, Don't Drop the Beat, Perfect Mash-Up, Wheel of Impossible Karaoke, Slay It, Don't Spray It and many more.

name: Shironeko Project: Zero Chronicle
summary: In a world consisting of numerous isles, a young hero from the Astora Isle encounters the adventurer Kyle and follows him on an expedition on the isle. They meet a mysterious girl named Iris and a talking white cat, and together they make their way to the isle's ruins, where they find a flying island. Kyle becomes consumed by darkness there, and the party resolves to travel to the ends of the world on the flying island in order to find the seven "Great Runes," following Kyle's words before he disappeared.

name: Winter Begonia
summary: This is a legendary story that took place in Peiping in the 1930s. The patriotic hot-blooded businessman Cheng Feng Tai and the most talented Peking Opera actor Shang Xi Rui became bosom friends because of the opera. Together they forged ahead amid the chaos of the operatic circle and war, and strengthened the belief of revitalizing Peking Opera and the lofty ideal of saving the country with their own lives. Finally, they joined hands to fight against the cruel fate.

name: Somewhere South
summary: Host and award-winning chef Vivian Howard explores the lesser known roots of southern food, cooking and living. Howard also examines cross-cultural dishes, such as dumplings and beans and rice, enjoyed by diverse communities. Breaking bread with farm laborers, doctors, entrepreneurs, ecologists, chefs, grandmothers and more unearths the complex values, identities and storied pasts of the southern United States.

name: Your Highness, The Class Monitor
summary: Your Highness, The Class Monitor follows the life  of Gu Zi Chen, a rebellious son of a wealthy family, and Su Nia Nian, a competitive student who has to adjust to a school that she never wanted. Because of an accidental meeting, the two start a relationship of constant bickering and eventually fall in love.

name: Putin: A Russian Spy Story
summary: An exploration of how Vladimir Putin deployed his knowledge of spy-craft as a politician, and how modern Russia evolved through an acute sense of betrayal, pride and anger.

name: Jamie: Keep Cooking and Carry On
summary: Jamie Oliver shows the nation some incredible recipes, tips and hacks, specifically tailored for the unique times we're living in, and how to make the most of our kitchen staples.

name: Maxxx
summary: Hilariously outrageous comedy that takes a cringe-inducing peek behind the pop world's curtain as former boyband star turned tabloid laughing stock Maxxx tries to relaunch his music career.

name: Deadwax
summary: Deadwax is a mindbending neo-noir set in the obsessive world of vinyl collecting. Etta Pryce, a vinyl tracker, is hired by a rich collector to hunt a legendary rare record that has driven its owners mad and killed anyone that has dared to play it. The more she learns about how impossibly dangerous, and real, this record may actually be, the more seduced she becomes by the temptation of hearing it herself - no matter what the cost.

name: Behind Her Faith
summary: Four women at the top of their game examine their personal journeys, highlighting the power of faith as their driving force.

name: Nate and Jeremiah Save My House
summary: A dynamic duo revitalizes their hometown one property at a time.

name: Inside the Force: 24/7
summary: Life inside a busy police station.

name: Nikki Fre$h
summary: Nicole Richie spreads her message of environmental love through her new musical persona, Nikki Fre$h, a trap music artist who makes eco-conscious choices while dropping sick beats and performing in over the top music videos.

name: One Night in the Museum
summary: With no adults around to supervise them, three groups of children from different primary schools visit some of Britain's greatest museums after hours.

name: The Circle France
summary: Status and strategy collide in this social media competition where online players flirt, befriend and catfish their way toward 100,000 euros.

name: Bill Oddie's How to Watch Wildlife
summary: Bill Oddie presents the definitive guide to finding and understanding Britain's wildlife.
